reviews.text: Best vets Kate and the team are the best
Great service, I needed a same day appointment and my senior cat is extremely nervous visiting the vet. Charlotte was very kind and helpful and listened to my concerns.
Jess is always so so lovely everytime we visit. Very understanding and caring
Visited twice with our cat and found them caring and helpful.
Vet was friendly but professional she explained everything that was going to happen.

I am a client for 1 5 years, always had and have a pet or 2.
This one I needed in the worst hour when I got bad news about both of my babies and hence, I had  a chance to meet at least 3 of the vets here.
Can I just say how please I was with dt Daniel,  dr Agatha  and Katy, or Kathy???cannot remember clear her name ....
It is important as a health care professional myself , how you do this job, and yes, knowledge is important but communication skills are equally important.
Best ever these guys. ..
Excellent customer service, the vet explained everything clearly and reassured us

Awful waiting times… just keep you waiting with no explanation. They tell you 10 mins then it’s another 10 mins. They act like the clients have  nothing else to do but wait around . Even staff can be unhelpful. You’d think your being treated for free the way they keep you waiting … when you are paying!
Unhelpful.

Disgraceful treatment of a loyal 4-cat client after a confirmed equipment errorReview:I am absolutely appalled by Vets for Pets Beckton. We take all 4 of our cats to this clinic, but after how the management treated us, we will never trust them again.Our 7-month-old kitten (a late-maturing Maine Coon & Bombay mix) had a blood test that generated a severely low calcium result. For a large-breed mix like a Maine Coon, severe calcium deficiency is far more dangerous than for normal-sized cats due to their rapid bone growth. Instead of handling this professionally, the vet did not even apologize when delivering the second set of results. They completely ignored the breed-specific risks and just aggressively pushed for her to be neutered right away.This faulty "analyser error" put my family through an entire week of pure, agonizing stress, believing our kitten was gravely ill. We were forced to book an urgent repeat test and pay for Uber Pet transport just to save our cat.Despite explicitly admitting in writing that their own equipment failed, the practice manager flatly refused to refund the £114.00 repeat test and travel costs (£130.75 total). The management was incredibly arrogant, dismissive, and flegmatic towards me. To make matters worse, they abruptly closed internal communication and have now officially refused independent mediation through the VCMS as well.They have zero empathy for a disabled client and zero loyalty to a customer with 4 cats. A multimillion-pound chain is fighting over £130 caused by their own faulty machinery. Unprofessional, greedy, and heartless. Avoid them!

They are normally alright but last time a male vet - possibly Australian saw my cat. It was not a pleasant experience, I felt judged and it was not helpful. I felt his attitude was antagonistic. Next time if I need my cat seen I would rather wait than having the cat seen by him.

Not recommended.
Had an appointment at 3.15 for second vacillation of my cat which had been booked days in advance. The receptionist didn’t tell the vet I was there.
When the other receptionist saw me 50
Minutes later and asked if I had an appointment I said yes. Only then did the first receptionist tell the vet whilst all the time they were both laughing . Saw the vet who was also laughing at the situation. So will not be going back there.
I’m a local Magistrate so may be some kind of a payback, but certainly not recommending them and will spread the word of this appalling behaviour

Fantastic customer service.
Vets take great care and time with your pets.
My cat booked in to be pts. I left with Rebal and treatment by Daniel has a marked improvement all ready!
Thank you Beckton!

I can’t thank the team at Vets for Pets Beckton enough for the wonderful care they gave my dog, Loki.

Kate Harrison was absolutely fantastic. Loki came because of swelling in the face, and Kate carried out a thorough examination, explaining everything clearly and answering all of my questions. She was incredibly kind, knowledgeable, and reassuring, which made what was a very stressful situation so much easier to deal with. I felt completely confident that Loki was in the best hands.

After the appointment, the nurse (whose name I sadly didn’t catch) went through all of Loki’s aftercare in detail and made sure I understood everything before we left. The instructions were clear, and I really appreciated the time she took to make sure I felt comfortable caring for him at home.

I’d also like to thank the reception team. They managed to get us an appointment quickly, and their communication was excellent from start to finish. They responded promptly to emails, kept me updated, and were even happy to help me with my insurance claim, which made the whole process so much easier.

Everyone at the practice was friendly, professional, and genuinely caring. Thank you all for looking after Loki so well—I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend Vets for Pets Beckton to anyone looking for exceptional veterinary care.

I have been bringing my Shih Tzu Missy here for 14 years and the service has always been excellent. A special thank you to the reception staff at the Beckton branch. They are always so friendly, helpful, and efficient whenever I call or visit. It makes a huge difference when the first people you meet are so welcoming and kind. Highly recommend! Thank you to Zoe, Sue, Jess and team.
My dog was very unwell in the surgery the care given to me and my dog was above and beyond due to their swift action she was able to make a full recovery I can’t thank them enough

Thank you for taking the time to leave us a review. We appreciate all feedback, as it helps us understand how we are doing and where we can improve.

We are sorry to see that your experience didn't fully meet your expectations. If you would be willing to share more about your visit, we would really value the opportunity to learn from your feedback and address any concerns. Please do not hesitate to get in touch with our team.

Thank you so much for your 5-star review.  We are delighted you had a positive experience with us.

Your support means a lot to our whole team, and we look forward to welcoming you and your pet again in the future. 🐾
Never answer the phones and when they do they cut it off as they say they cannot hear you, this is frustrating after waiting for so long
All the staff are really helpful, they seriously care about you and your pet, i could not ask for a better treatment. Zoe specially will go above and beyond, lovely vet :)

I have been using Vets for Pets for around 30 years or so and find this practice a truly outstanding place of which i wholeheartedly trust every single person there with my dogs I have had past and present. The vets have always been amazing and extremely thorough and have done everything they  possibly could  to find a reason or a cause for any of my dogs problems or sickness. They have always taken feelings into account but the welfare of my  dogs has always been their no 1 priority. The reception staff are absolutely fantastic, nothing is ever too much trouble. Even during busy periods they remain so friendly and professional and go above and beyond to be so helpful and supportive from making appointments, giving help and advice, and being so very compassionate in the worst times
The whole practice is exceptional and I would never want to take my dogs anywhere else
Outstanding service from our vets. Always a friendly welcome and our cat Rex so well looked after. Highly recommend.
Staff are very kind and helpful. Customer service is excellent. Myself and my puppy unique was very content .

I cannot thank the team at Vets4Pets enough, especially Daniel and the nursing staff, for the care and compassion they showed both me and my dog.

My dog developed maternal aggression after having her puppies, and for everyone's safety, it was time for her to be spayed. Because of her unpredictable behaviour, I brought her in wearing a muzzle. When the nurse came to collect her, I explained the situation and my concerns. Rather than rushing ahead, she listened carefully and went to speak with the vet.

Daniel then invited us into a consultation room so he could observe my dog himself. He took the time to explain everything thoroughly and discussed all the options with me. He was honest about the fact that the operation could potentially improve or worsen her behaviour and suggested that I could also work with a dog behaviourist either before or after the procedure. I really appreciated that he wasn't just focused on the surgery but on what was best for my dog overall.

To make the experience as stress-free as possible, Daniel suggested sedating her in the room with me present. This meant she could relax and fall asleep with me by her side before being taken through for surgery, which was incredibly reassuring.

What really touched me was the call I received after the operation. I was asked if I could head back to the practice because they had just finished surgery and wanted me to be there when my dog woke up. Being able to be with her as she came round from the anaesthetic made such a difference to both of us.

The whole team went above and beyond to make my dog feel safe and comfortable, while also helping me feel reassured during what was a very worrying time. Their kindness, understanding, and genuine care were outstanding. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend Vets4Pets to anyone looking for a veterinary team that truly puts animals and their owners first.

I've had a very positive experience at Beckton Vets4Pets. My two senior cats have been registered here for many years, and throughout that time the care and support they've received have been excellent.
The entire team is friendly, professional, and genuinely cares about the wellbeing of both pets and their owners.
I'd particularly like to thank Kate Harrison, who has been fantastic throughout. She’s knowledgeable, compassionate, and always willing to take the time to explain things clearly and put any worries at ease.
A special mention also goes to Jess on reception, who is always welcoming, helpful, and efficient, making every visit run smoothly.
I'd also like to thank Zoe for all her help with insurance claims. She's very efficient and happy to assist whenever needed. Her support has made the claims process much smoother and far less stressful.
I wouldn't hesitate to recommend Beckton Vets4Pets to anyone looking for a veterinary team they can trust.

Absolutely Brilliant!
We have been bringing our Boxer dog, Ollie here for over 10 years to have his annual checkups, boosters and more recently, his monthly arthritis medication. The service we have received has been absolutely brilliant! Everyone is super friendly and super helpful and the care and advice that is provided is top!
We would not take our dogs, Ollie and our new rescue Lara anywhere else. (even after we have moved an hour away away up into Essex 😅).
Overall, super happy with the service and it is always worth the drive!
(P.s I don't think Ollie would let us take him to another vet at this point 😁)

The consultations are over in 10 minutes and arent thorough, if you are lucky to be called in on time without waiting for 20 minutes with your cat meowing in the carrier. I went for two consultations with my cat about an ongoing issue and nothing helped. The second consultation they dismissed the symptoms with no treatment (feline hyperesthesia) until I insisted we try a drug I researched about. Still didnt help but at least I insisted on trying this out.

I lost hope for resolution with Vets for Pets and registered with a different vet for a second opinion. The consultation lasted well over 30 minutes and they took a detailed look at my cat including her skin condition, prescribed medication and on the first dose my cats symptoms have gone away! Vets for Pets never even suggested steroids as a treatment option to help her. The new vets actually reassured me and explained in great detail what other options can be tried. I feel like with Vets for Pets it was never about any diagnosis, just to get the appointment over and done with.

It really seems to me that the practice has very short slots with vet doctors always rushed off their feet, which means the care you want to have for your poorly pet is often based on quick judgement rather than a proper assessment.

⭐☆☆☆
First I was frightened, then I lost £100.
Maybe I lost £100, but Vets for Pets Beckton lost a loyal customer and a treatment plan worth around £1,000 because of poor communication and a lack of transparency.

I visited for my cat's vaccination. During the consultation I was told there could be serious dental issues, which understandably worried me. I then specifically requested an X-ray appointment and repeatedly asked whether there would be any additional charges beyond the X-ray.

I was told that any treatment would happen on a different day and that this appointment was for X-rays only. Based on that information, I paid a £100 deposit.

On the day of the appointment, I discovered that in addition to the quoted X-ray fee (£269.85), there was also an anaesthesia charge of approximately £157. My issue is not that anaesthesia may be required. My issue is that I specifically asked whether there would be any other charges and was never clearly told about this cost.

When I raised my concerns, I was simply told that it was included somewhere in the quotation. I am a customer, not a veterinary professional. Technical documents are not a substitute for clear verbal explanations, especially when a client directly asks about additional costs.

I left without proceeding, lost my £100 deposit, and felt completely unheard. Had everything been explained clearly from the start, I would have budgeted accordingly and likely proceeded with the treatment.

Very disappointing experience.

This is the worst Vet I have ever been too.  The Vet didn't even acknowledge my dog when we went in, she was annoyed with me when I could not hold him still to look in his ears and then when I couldn't afford £220 for various medicine (which I am confident my dog does not need), she huffed and puffed and said 'well it is your decision'.  I will never return here!

I've been bringing my cats to Vets for Pets for years, my two senior cats have been patients here for a decade, and when we recently got kittens, there was no question about where we would take them.

We've visited a few times with the kittens recently, including for their vaccinations, when one hurt her paw and when they weren't eating, and every experience has been positive. The reception team are consistently warm, compassionate, and reassuring; exactly what you need when you're worried about a pet.

I particularly want to mention Sidney, the vet we saw on our most recent visit. She was incredibly patient, took the time to listen to our concerns properly, and it was clear she genuinely cared about our kittens' wellbeing. It made a stressful situation feel much more manageable.

I trust this place with my senior cats and now my kittens too - couldn't recommend more highly!

unfortunately I felt there was a lot of pressure and scarcity around making decisions quickly. I was told I likely wouldn’t be able to take my pet elsewhere, which added to the stress. What started as a relatively low-cost appointment ended up exceeding over £1,000. the reception staff and manager were kind and helpful throughout, which is the reason I’m not leaving a lower rating. I noticed similar concerns mentioned in other reviews, I genuinely hope this feedback is taken on board ..

My dog Oscar is Belgian Mali and very reactive at the vets due to prior bad experience. He went in for a teeth scale and polish along with nail trim. He was sadated at home and then further sadated in the vets. Dan was very good with him, sad on the floor with Oscar before sedation to get him used to him, once sadated procedure done Dan brought Oscar out to me and out Oscar on and under a blanket and Dan day in the floor once again to comfort Oscar whilst he came round.
Dan made what could have been a stressful situation a very calming experience which helps Oscar as he is no where near as stressed as he could have been.
“I’ve noticed a pattern of generic positive reviews appearing right after negative ones. It raises questions about their authenticity, especially as the negative reviews reflect my own experience.

Fairly average veterinary service.
Get the job done.
Very very average customer service.
Front desk staff could do with a refresher customer relations course too.

I honestly cannot recommend Vets for Pets enough. I have 5 animals, so over time I’ve met pretty much all of the staff, and every single person has been amazing. The whole team is incredibly welcoming, kind, professional, and genuinely caring towards both pets and owners.

No matter which of my animals has needed help, the vets and nurses have always been so thorough and attentive. They take the time to explain everything properly, answer every question, and make sure both me and my pets feel comfortable and cared for. You can really tell how knowledgeable and passionate they are about animals.

My pets are always treated with so much patience and kindness, and that means everything to me as an owner. The reception staff are lovely, the vets are brilliant, and the overall atmosphere is calm, friendly, and reassuring.

My experience here has honestly been nothing but positive. They have consistently gone above and beyond for all of my animals, and I truly believe they are the perfect vets to trust with your pets’ care.

Thank you to the whole team for everything you do — you are all amazing!

Horrible experience.
This place needs to be investigated.
My cat had a car accident in September last year, I was told I was gonna be charged £6000 for consultation and surgery and then somehow at the end I ended up paying nearly £9k.
After my cats leg surgery did not work,
We were told the amputation of the leg would be free as we already paid a big amount and it did not work. We agreed to the amputation as we were told about it being free and the next day we receive an email saying it was charged nearly £1400 and we have no choice but to pay.
SO UNFAIR! they charge random number however they want and deal with situations very unprofessionally and rudely as one time my sister was told to leave after she went to complain and ask for further information about the costs.
Moreover, my cat is now traumatised and very very scared to go to the vet and before that my cat went several times and never had issues, I believe something major has happened on how they treat animals  in that place.

Will never return to this place!
Always had a good experience bringing my cats to V4P Beckton.  staff all clearly care about their clients both animal and human and offer a high level of care.

My experience of Vets for Pets was a positive one. I found the staff to be kind caring and patient. Over the past few months Dan took great care of our cat,  even to the end when we had to put him to sleep Dan explained everything to us and made sure we understood what was happening. Thank you Vets for Pets!

Our pooch has a gingival lesion found yesterday. Emailed P4V not expecting an answer until Monday (today). Kate phoned us within the hour and gave us an appt. today am. Pooch now booked in for surgery tomorrow am. Thank you. Much appreciated, we know it’s likely benign but it helps to be seen ASAP. We are pleased with the service and happy to recommend.
Vets and reception team are very caring, efficient, professional and very friendly. Amazing team!

Horrible experience, I was left with my cat waiting in the waiting room for 40 minutes without knowing what was going on, then when I asked the receptionist she said there was an emergency so she wasn't sure how long I had to wait still...then when was about to go home a vet decided to see my cat, he was rude, upset and didn't even liste to what I was telling him, he literally looked at my cat for 5 minutes without caring at all and that was it...I have never felt so ignored and disrespected, also it was so horrible to trust my cat to  a vet who didn't even care and who just wanted to end the visit and get paid...avoid this place if you can

I am not surprised for seeing too many bad reviews. I have brought my kitten for first vaccinations and they didn’t warn me that the second vaccine should be done no later than 1 month or I should need to start a whole new course. I was abroad and I planned to bring my kitten for a second vaccine when I am back, just for them to tell me that we need to start all over again. I have paid extra 35£ again. Receiption staff is weird on the phone…

Fees are not transparent. I won't recommend this clinic. Paid 25 deposit for consultation. It turns out this fee was reallocated for 7 pills without any authorizations. Same pill two weeks ago cost 25 pounds for 14 pills. Price doubled in two weeks. This only 0.76 per bill online. Be careful when you pay for deposit or anything in this clinic.

Thank you for your 5-star review.

We really appreciate you taking the time to share your feedback and are so pleased you had a positive experience with our team.

Best wishes,
The Beckton Vets for Pets Team

I've always had a good experience here, my cats are very nervous and the vets/nurses have taken extra care to make sure they feel safe. I love that there is a separate cats/dogs section in the waiting room and they make people stick to the correct side.

not a great experience. i was here since 10 in the morning until 5pm. they didnt tell me until 1pm that i shouldve gone home. the vet told me the ear flush procedure would take about 2 hours max. but no! i stayed until 5.

another thing, when i went for the consultation, they told me an estimate of the price (£360) INCLUDING medication. next day i went for the actual procedure, when the vet came out he told me ANOTHER price. it went up to £478. THEN, the vet called me again and said it will go up to 661. and finally the actual price was almost 700 pounds. suuuper professional guys..!!

last thing, when my dog came out of the procedure, obviously he was in there for quite a while. he smelt very weird. not like what he smelt like when i brought him. he smelt like genuine dog. NOT in a good way. clearly, they do not clean the cages they keep the dogs in before procedure! i am telling you guys, this smell was REALLY bad. i cannot believe how unhygienic they place really is. the least you couldve done was CLEAN THE CAGES.

probably the worse vet you could go to. do not come here!!!!!

My cat was brewing an infection, as a nurse, I was pushing the vets for antibiotics. The vet declined and made him come back everyday for 3 days for just fluids and one set of bloods. All this costed nearly £1k. Finally asked for antibiotics and he was back to baseline within 4 days… they overcharge and squeeze money out of you
Over priced for eye treatment please avoid.
Medicine and vet very expensive , seems there are no competitors so they charge you whatever they want
Daniel the vet is an absolute legend he explained everything perfectly he even drew a diagram. Couldn’t be happier with the service provided, hopefully it helps my dog buster back to full health.

The head vet (Kate Harrison) is sarcastic and cold. She does not possess any people skills and she's not great with pets either. If you ask her what she in her professional opinion thinks caused an eye ulcer for example chances are all you'll get is a sarcastic response. She is unable to contain her anger in front of people in the waiting room. I cannot in good conscience recommend this practice.

I’m disappointed with my recent experience at this vet clinic. They seem completely unorganised and consistently overbook appointments far beyond the slots they have available. Even when you book a specific time, you end up waiting well over the agreed appointment window, sometimes for hours, with no clear updates or explanations.

The reception team also doesn’t appear to be on top of things. Communication is poor, and there’s little effort to manage the backlog or keep clients informed. For a place that handles pets’ health and wellbeing, I expected a much more professional and efficient service.
Phoned for ages, eventually answered and then hung up. Didn't call me back and didn't answer when I called again

My cat died here after dental surgery. My cat was admitted at 9am and surgery did not take place until after 4pm (after fasting since the previous night). Surgery was rushed as they were closing at 7am and there was no way they could have performed the operation safely or removed that many teeth in such a short space of time. At no point did they tell me what the surgery would entail. Told me my cat had been slow to come out of anaesthesia (which they denied later). My cat was not given enough time to recover before being sent home. She died a few minutes after leaving the surgery. Told it was my fault as I signed the consent form.  Keep your pets away from this practice at all costs.

Disorganised and inconsistent. Our cats have been registered here since adoption. One receptionist said we must bring the cats in to be weighed to collect flea and worming treatment, despite them being weighed three months earlier. Another said we were already eligible and could collect without issue.
The online booking system does not work. In 2025 this should be basic. Phones ring for a long time just to book an appointment that an online system should handle.
Staff appear unfamiliar with their own IT system and were surprised to see we are registered. The issue is not pricing or care quality. It is a lack of organisation and consistent process.
They are clearly overbooked, but I believe focusing on organisation, training and automation would make them cope with the demand and provide a better customer service.
My partner and I stress out when our cats have an issue, not because of the issue per se but because we will have to deal with them.
Unfortunately, they are the only vets in Beckton, maybe they need a bit of a competition to up their game?

Neutering on my cat Molly was done well and there were no complications but two observations: 1) I was given a 9.10am appointment. I wasn't seen until 10am. My cat is an indoor cat and is quite nervous. Having her in an extended stressful situation is not good. 2) Secondly, I was told to come and pick my cat up at about 1.30pm. I arrived at 2.40pm giving ample time for them to get her ready. Despite several requests for an update I did not finally get me cat back until gone 4pm, 90 mins after I arrived to pick her up.  Given she was supposed to be ready to go home at 1.30pm, having to wait 90 mins after I had already given them over an hour extra is just ludicrous. The reception staff seem to be rather apathetic and made me feel awkward when asking for updates. Will go back to my usual vets at Goddards from now on.

disgusting disgusting place! they need to be investigated for their malpractice. We took our kitten here because he seemed ill they completely brushed it off and gave medicine for his stomach only after WE told him he wasn’t eaten and said he was fine otherwise. A week later and he’s brain dead and now has died, we took him to different vets who told us that he had been ill for weeks and was not given appropriate medicine. This is disgusting , I won’t even go into detail on how abysmal their customer service is. But for vets to be so negligent is completely horrible. They caused our babies death, stay far far away.
Rude and incompetent management, avoid this Vets4Pets branch especially if you have cats

Used online system for appointments and they just emailed saying they don’t have any on that day. What a way to waste time. Could have offered alternative slots. They were also rude to my sister on the phone so she left. Enjoy declining client numbers.

Absolutely ridiculous customer service. Trying to get through to this vet has been a nightmare. It says to call for emergencies and they do not answer the phone?
I tried to transfer to another vets as my animal needed to be seen asap and I have spent every hour of my Saturday calling them. I got through once and the lady said ‘hold the line please’ put me on hold for 15 minutes and cut the call.
Do not recommend.

Called the emergency line about a stray cat whose extremely fatigued and weak, along with gunk infested eyes that look like they’re rotting. Told me to call back on line two as him being malnourished isn’t an emergency enough. The guy can barely reach the litter tray. Was on hold for an extortionate amount of time and eventually gave up. I recommend any vet over this one. Don’t waste your time, they don’t care.
Jess is always amazing and helpful! Love how friendly she is and goes beyond to help us always! She’s stunning too!!!

I don’t usually post reviews but please stay away from this place if you love your pet! They need to work on their pet and people skills. Firstly we arrived for a 9am appointment along with 6 other people and only 3 vet rooms- they are clearly very greedy and only care for profit over experience  as they are overbooking! We should have left when a man showed up to reception and said he had been given dog worming tablets instead of cats. Truly showing their lack of care. We saw a vet called Kate and feel truly offended by her treatment of us and our cat. We queried an extremely high price only to be made to feel guilty and be referred to as “low income” which is not the case! She was extremely rude and we came out with more questions than when we went in. When she knew she couldn’t get any money from us for any treatment she stopped engaging with us or even helping our cat with applying a very simple bandage. These people are not animal people or even people people! Please stay away.

Worst vet ever.  Zoe Kate  Agata.  All stick together.  Absolutely no people skills.  Disgusting  the way they treat their customers.  A money making scheme with no compassion for anyone
Avoid this place at all costs!!!!!!!!!!!

Miss Diagnosed my dog  i kept telling them something was wrong but they said  it was not what i thought. i took the dog to another vet for second opinion. and the dog needed emergency surgery as the dog had a foreign body in the stomach  and could of died. i saved my dogs life by not taking the vets word for it  and the attitude i got back when i was adamant that there was more wrong with the dog. miss Diagnose can kill your dog  yes it can happen but by reading the comments on any vets 4 pets sites there is a lot of this goes on

Highly recommend, they are amazing not only with our pet but also with pet owners.
I give 5 starts not only for the Vet's but also for the whole vets 4 pets and pets at home Team.

I brought my kitten to this clinic when she began showing signs of serious respiratory distress. She was diagnosed with pneumonia based on an X-ray and was sent home with antibiotics. I trusted the diagnosis and followed the treatment plan.

Tragically, just a short time later, my kitten had to be put to sleep due to how severe it became.

After seeking a second opinion, I learned that she was actually suffering from a severe heart condition, not pneumonia. The original diagnosis was not only incorrect—it meant she didn’t receive the urgent care she truly needed. What’s more concerning is that the vet later admitted the X-ray equipment they used was not advanced, which raises serious questions about how reliable the diagnosis ever was.

The pain of losing her is something I carry every day, and knowing that a more accurate diagnosis or better equipment might have changed the outcome is devastating.

I understand that no clinic is perfect and not every case has a happy ending—but pet owners deserve transparency, up-to-date diagnostics, and the option of a referral when a case is complex or uncertain. I’m writing this not out of anger, but out of heartbreak, and in the hope that sharing our story may help prevent another pet from being misdiagnosed—and another person from going through the pain of an avoidable loss.

Waiting time always 25-40 minutes, no seats available because so many people are waiting
You get there early just in case and spend almost 1 hour waiting
Very poor service

I recently cared for an unwell cat that my neighbors had kicked out. Suspecting he was unvaccinated, he became very ill with symptoms like vomiting, lethargy, and low body temperature. I nursed him with syringe feeding and an electric heat pad. Given my neighbor's dog had similar symptoms and died, I was extremely worried.

On Easter (Sunday), I checked the Beckton Vets4Pets website, which stated they were open from 10:30. This was incorrect and the website wasn't updated. I called Romford Vets4Pets (AMAZING RECEPTIONIST) out of hours and scheduled a consultation without issue. However, I canceled as my cat started eating on his own and I didn't want to stress him with a long journey. They were very understanding and told me to call back if my cat got unwell again.

BAD review is about Beckton receptionist (I was not able to see the vet):
On Monday at 10:00, the Beckton Vets4Pets receptionist called me back after I had requested app online (on Sun) and refused to give me an appointment, stating I needed to go to my regular out of hours vet as I wasn't registered with them. She suggested Wanstead Goddards for out-of-hours care, which costs £280.
I believe this is INCORRECT INFORMATION!  Despite knowing my cat was extremely unwell and acknowledging a virus was going around, she advised me to go to my regular vet next time.

I care for 16 TNR cats and 5 others, and sometimes use Goddard in Plaistow as I no longer can use Celia Hammonds (no vets). As I do not drive these vets are easy for me to reach with a bus. The receptionist was rude and unhelpful, saying she called to check on my cat.

I will never use your services again. I've heard and read bad reviews, and I'd rather pay extra elsewhere than deal with such poor service and not knowing if cat gonna be taken care of anyway. Utterly disgusting.

Very disappointed with my recent visit, the young nurse that I saw did not put me at ease with my pet, upon my cat everything was an oh my god, this and oh my god that. I thought my cat was as deaths door the way she reacted rather than asking my permission on anything just went ahead with a scan that was completely unnecessary. Not advising the cost along the way as unfortunately not everyone has an open wallet and understandable costs are high for pet care. The vet made me feel like my pet was not cared for. I left very upset and very unsupported. I went to another veterinary clinic with the detailed clinical report from vets for pets and it was all unnecessary and all unjust on the report. I would not recommend this service to anyone.

We had a couple of bad experiences at Vets4Pets Beckton. We have 2 main gripes firstly the vets don’t have good enough English to communicate properly. We had a terrible time with Nuria so much so my dog at the 2nd visit recognised she had made her ill before & was trying to get away from her. The 2nd issue is that despite being on a plan they always upsold medicines that were not needed. On one occasion they gave her Metacam which she had a violent reaction against. I think it caused an ulcer but unclear as Nuria could only punch her stomach in explanation as her English is poor. Nuria had no idea what was wrong with our dog so grasped at her having an X-ray under anaesthesia costing £400. If it had been necessary we would have done it. She implied it could be heart when she is 2 years old and as fit as a fiddle. I am appalled that she could suggest something so drastic when not needed.
Luckily we have a new independent vets opened near us. The contrast is unbelievable.
Please do not take your pets here. The vets are inexperienced, told to just upsell and can’t communicate.

Very good at charging exorbitant prices but not very effective in treating pets (if you are going to charge high prices then at least be good at your job). No evidence of actual treatment plans. Very basic service with limited advice ( my insurance vets provided a lot more useful advice on how to support my pet during serious ill health including the best food to feed them which strangely isnt a consideration of this vets. I would have thought the right food is crucial).

The vets have a superiority complex (in spite of being not being very effective) and have poor interpersonal skills (especially Kate Harrison and Agata Malaga) - get quite stroppy if you ask them to repeat information for clarity.  Kate Harrison had the audacity to get stroppy as I could not give her an answer re whether to go ahead with some treatment in spite of her not being fully transparent about pricing (could only give some idea although she did add how the prices were good value). At that point, I was thinking that if I am to spend more money, I would rather my pet see a competent specialist. Very sadly, my pet passed away later that day. I wonder whether Kate had an idea of my pet nearing death yet was still recommending costly last minute treatment which would have been futile and stressful for my pet. Poor.

I am devastated and furious at the negligence that led to my beloved cat Bonnie’s unnecessary suffering. I brought her in, worried about a rapid decline in vision and unusual behaviour. The vet, Agata Malaga, falsely diagnosed her with Glaucoma, telling me her eye pressure was dangerously high—yet on the appointment notes state it was completely normal. She was prescribed painful medication that caused her distress, and within days, she was blind, unable to walk, seizing and deteriorating rapidly.

I begged for urgency when Bonnie’s condition worsened, but this practice showed nothing but indifference. No compassion, no responsibility—just delay after delay. When I finally saw a specialist, I learned the truth: Bonnie NEVER had Glaucoma. She had a rare and aggressive neurological lymphoma that should have been properly investigated from the start. Instead, this practice's laziness and incompetence stole the precious time she had left, leaving her to suffer unnecessarily.

Bonnie’s final days were filled with pain and fear because of this practice. Their negligence cost her comfort, and it cost me my last moments with her. I will never forgive them. DO NOT trust them with your pet’s life!!!

I wish I had read the reviews before trusting them with my beautiful Bonnie—there are so many reviews that have shared similar horror stories!!!
amazing service

Reception staff are the only thing worth anything in this place. Hidden fees and a diffrent vet everytime you go! Ridiculous treatment.

By far the best Vets ai’ve used. Our cat is quite poorly and has some complex needs, but I can’t fault how helpful, accomodating and compassionate Vets4Pets Beckton have been. From reception staff through to the Vets themselves, they have always been more than happy to answer questions and provide advice. Great people and really great care.

Many many years I had a bad experience at this establishment and vowed not to go back. I have taken our cat to them many times. We have been charged exorbitant fees every time. Last time, we spent  less than 5 minutes - the consultation discovered absolutely nothing, yet the prescription was for metacab for £35 and another £35 for the consulation. we also waited very long to be seen and even to pay. ridiculous charges. will no longer use them.

Vets4Pets took amazing care of my cat before I adopted him. He was found as a stray, injured and in rough shape, and they went above and beyond to help him. His damaged eye had to be removed, and he had other wounds, but they treated everything, neutered him, vaccinated him, and made sure he was ready for a fresh start.

After a couple of weeks, they started looking for a new home for him, which is when I came across him. Now he’s settled in with me and doing so well! I’m so thankful to Kate and the team for giving him the second chance he deserved 😻
Whenever I've been there I haven't experienced anything negative. I love the acquarium part of the shop.

Vets4Pets has been an absolute disappointment. I came in for a simple nail clipping for my dog, and they made me wait over 40 minutes past my appointment time. The staff was incredibly rude, showing no regard for my time or concerns. I wasted my entire lunch break waiting, only to end up late for work. If you’re looking for a quick and professional service, avoid Vets4Pets altogether. Just go next door to the Groom Room—they’re fantastic and know how to treat both you and your pet with respect!

Was here with my cat who had stopped eating the vet did a blood test , gave him an injection and adviced all sorts of treatments but didn't see the cyst in his mouth which my boyfriend discovered just 2 days later after my cat still wouldn't eat. I called the reception as soon as we discovered the cyst and explained what happened and she didn't even apologise nor was she willing to give us any new appointment the same or next day but only 5 days later. Said to her: my cat is not eating because of the cyst in his mouth what shall I do until the appointment? She just said she can't help me.
Great when they answer the phone.  Its getting them to answer it and actually get an appointment that is nearly impossible.  Its Monday afternoon and I've been calling since morning and no answer.

They double book people and don't tell you. Someone else had the same time as me which was really frustrating as I had somewhere to be after. They should atleast tell you this aswell. Bare in mind that at weekends they only have one vet available but they don't tell you this over the phone either. Just overheard by chance.
The vet I saw was very patronising and may aswell have said I was a liar.

Completely went down hill, misdiagnosed my dog and did not run simple x-ray, insisting my dog needed a drip all most every day.

I chose to change vets who immediately by touching my dogs stomach said something is wrong, took him to a CT Scan he had a foreign object in his intestine and he didn't make it through surgery as it was too late!

I will NEVER FORGIVE this place! NEVER!
Friendly and helpful staff and convenient to have a vets, a pet shop and grooming service all under one roof.

Check your pets have been registered to the correct owners!

Check if your pets have been registered under the correct names when microchipped and make sure they do procedures in front of you.

4 years ago I went to Beckton vets4pets to have my cats vaccinated. I paid for a package which included micro chips and 2 vaccinations. I asked them not to micro chip them at the time, I requested them to have 2 vaccinations only. They did 1 vaccination for each cat and did not do the second due to a shortage of vaccines. They did not refund me and only caused me an immense amount of stress. They confirmed in writing they did not micro chip my cats.

Fast forward 4 years, I finally found an independent vet I felt safe with after the distress vets4pets caused. They informed me that my cats had in fact been previously microchipped and more troubling, they had been registered to different owners.

When I joined the new vets, Vets4pets Beckton did not disclose the microchipping in the patient history. Which shows either extreme negligence or attempt to hide the matter in the hopes I would not discover it. I am unsure why this has happened however it is disgraceful and extremely worrying.

Please please please check your pets are registered to the correct owners and have had the right procedures done. I was not allowed in the room when they were doing the vaccinations and now have no idea if anything they say is true.

As mentioned, i previously did not know about the microchipping however had correspondence with them regarding the vaccinations and they refused to refund me the vaccinations. I have called them now regarding this new matter in order to talk to the head of the practice who did not have time to talk. They asked me to send an email of which I have. I aim for this review to be informative and hopefully you can avoid all the distress they caused me.

My cat passed away after a procedure at this vet yesterday. He developed an abdominal mass on his stomach 2 weeks ago. The vet first informed us it's possible cancer so urged for us to do a biopsy, which we did. And then an x-ray. Without waiting for results and upon simple speculation, they then informed us this was a hernia operative procedure that they had to do on an emergency basis. Reassured my sister saying the chances of him passing are slim to none, that she's done plenty and put full confidence in my sister that it was immediate must as it was an obstructive hernia. After surgery was "successful" they told us actually, it's not hernia, it's a build up of tissue. He wasn't recovering from surgery well and that we should transfer him to OOH.

I called the vets to sort out financial affairs and then was abruptly transferred to a ?veterinarian. It was an extremely unanticipated phone call where he just suddenly announced "your cat storm has passed away". Misgendered him which made me think, is the right cat you are referring to? All in all, he was extremely apologetic however I don't think delivering news as devastating as this, should catch someone so off guard. I could've nearly had a heart attack.

Please be very wary for any ulterior motives these professionals may have. Seems like the quickest money grab is what they aim to attain.
